newsitem.title: USA: Genetic evidence points to African origin of humans.
newsitem.headline: Genetic evidence points to African origin of humans.

text.p: Scientists said on Monday they have gathered more genetic evidence to support the theory that humans originated in Africa.
The team studied nuclear DNA from 63 Asians, 72 Africans and 120 Europeans and found the greatest diversity in the Africans, a strong sign Africans are the "oldest" population.

"Greater genetic diversity in human populations from Africa has been a cornerstone of the argument for an African origin of modern humans, since this greater diversity suggests a greater 'age' for African populations," they wrote.
The team found 20 percent more diversity among Africans.

The report by Lynn Jorde at the University of Utah Health Sciences Centre and colleagues at the University of Helsinki and Pennsylvania State University will appear on Tuesday in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Science.
Other studies have produced similar conclusions, some using another part of genetic material known as mitochondrial DNA, the authors said.
